verdict.rationale: Base44's core interaction model is delegating app-building tasks to an AI assistant that generates designs, code, and content from natural-language prompts (docs-12,14,21; probe-1), and community testimonials confirm the AI assistant reliably executes substantial tasks like full app builds from prompts (comm-4,5,6), though some users note it's essentially an LLM wrapper (comm-1) and cost/quality tradeoffs (comm-8).
